
```{r}
NSAMP <- 10
getwd()
```



```{r}

bioactivity_add <- read.csv("~/PhD/chapter1/Raw/plastic_additives_bioactivity.csv")


```

```{r}

add_activity <- bioactivity_add[, c("chnm",
              "dtxsid",
              "casn",
              "spid",
              "hitc",
              "modl",
              "aeid",
              "ac50",
              "ac10",
              "acc")]

colnames(add_activity)[colnames(add_activity) == "dtxsid"] <- "DTXSID"

```

```{r}

toxcast.table <- NULL
for (this.id in unique(add_activity$DTXSID)[1:200])
{
  this.subset <- subset(add_activity, DTXSID == this.id)
  these.hits <- subset(this.subset, hitc==1)
  if (dim(these.hits)[1]>0){
      this.row <- data.frame(Compound=as.character(this.subset[1,"chnm"]),
                         DTXSID=this.id,
                         Total.Assays = dim(this.subset)[1],
                         Unique.Assays = length(unique(this.subset$aeid)),
                         Total.Hits = dim(these.hits)[1],
                         Unique.Hits = length(unique(these.hits$aeid)),
                         Low.AC50 = signif(min(these.hits$ac50),3),
                         Low.AC10 = signif(min(these.hits$ac10),3),
                         Low.ACC = signif(min(these.hits$acc, na.rm=TRUE),3),
                         Q10.AC50 = signif(quantile(these.hits$ac50,probs=0.1),3),
                         Q10.AC10 = signif(quantile(these.hits$ac10,probs=0.1),3),
                         Q10.ACC = signif(quantile(these.hits$acc,probs=0.1, na.rm=TRUE),3),
                         Med.AC50 = signif(median(these.hits$ac50),3),
                         Med.AC10 = signif(median(these.hits$ac10),3),
                         Med.ACC = signif(median(these.hits$acc, na.rm=TRUE),3),
                         Q90.AC50 = signif(quantile(these.hits$ac50,probs=0.9),3),
                         Q90.AC10 = signif(quantile(these.hits$ac10,probs=0.9),3),
                         Q90.ACC = signif(quantile(these.hits$acc,probs=0.9, na.rm=TRUE),3)
                         )
    toxcast.table <- rbind(toxcast.table, this.row)
  }
}

```

```{r}
library(httk)
library(readxl)
load_sipes2017()
load_pradeep2020()
load_dawson2021()

```

```{r}

for (this.id in unique(toxcast.table$DTXSID))
{
# get_cheminfo() gives a list of all the CAS numbers for which HTTK will work:
  if (this.id %in% get_cheminfo(info="dtxsid", suppress.messages=TRUE))
  {
# Set a random number generator seed so that the Monte Carlo will always give
# the same random sequence:
    set.seed(12345)
    toxcast.table[toxcast.table$DTXSID==this.id,"Css"] <- 
      calc_mc_css(dtxsid=this.id,
                  output.units="uM",
                  samples=NSAMP,
                  suppress.messages=TRUE)
    toxcast.table[toxcast.table$DTXSID==this.id,"Css.Type"] <- "in vitro"
  }
}

```


```{r}

for (this.id in unique(toxcast.table$DTXSID))
{
  if (this.id %in% get_cheminfo(info="dtxsid", suppress.messages=TRUE) &
    is.na(toxcast.table[toxcast.table$DTXSID==this.id,"Css"]))
  {
# Set a random number generator seed so that the Monte Carlo will always give
# the same random sequence:
    set.seed(12345)
    toxcast.table[toxcast.table$DTXSID==this.id,"Css"] <- 
      calc_mc_css(dtxsid=this.id,
                  output.units="uM",
                  samples=NSAMP,
                  suppress.messages=TRUE)
    toxcast.table[toxcast.table$DTXSID==this.id,"Css.Type"] <- "in silico"
  }
}


```

```{r}

BER.plot <- ggplot(data=toxcast.table) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=Compound,
                   xend=Compound,
                   y=(10^Q10.AC50)/Css,
                   yend=(10^Q90.AC50)/Css),
               size=1,
               color="red",
               alpha=0.5) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x=Compound,
                   xend=Compound,
                   y=seem3.l95,
                   yend=seem3.u95),
               size=1,
               color="blue",
               alpha=0.5) +   
  geom_point(aes(x=Compound,y=(10^Med.AC50)/Css),shape=3,color="red") +
  geom_point(aes(x=Compound,y=seem3),shape=3,color="blue") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=8)) + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=8)) + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    face = "bold", 
    hjust = 1, 
    vjust = 1, 
    size = 4, 
    angle = 45)) +
  ylab("Bioactive Dose & Exposure\nmg/kg BW/day") + 
  xlab("Chemicals Ranked By BER")
print(BER.plot)

```

```{r}

additives_cas = read_csv("~/PhD/chapter1/Raw/jason_additives_cas.csv", col_types = cols(
    CAS = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
)


```

```{r}

library(ctxR)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)


library(httk)

```


```{r}

# 3. Extract the CAS-to-DTXSID lookup table from httk
httk_lookup <- chem.physical_and_invitro.data[, c("CAS", "DTXSID", "Compound")]

```

```{r}

# Convert CAS columns to character
additives_cas$CAS <- as.character(additives_cas$CAS)
httk_lookup$CAS <- as.character(httk_lookup$CAS)

```


```{r}
# 4. Merge with your original dataframe (keeps all rows from your CSV)
df_mapped <- merge(additives_cas, httk_lookup, by.x = "CAS", by.y = "CAS", all.x = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Count total NAs in the DTXSID column
sum(is.na(df_mapped$DTXSID))

```


```{r}

# 1. Isolate only the unique CASRNs that failed to match in httk
missing_cas <- unique(na.omit(df_mapped$CAS[is.na(df_mapped$DTXSID) & df_mapped$CAS != ""]))

# 2. Batch query the CompTox API for the missing CASRNs
ctx_res <- chemical_equal_batch(word_list = missing_cas)

# 3. Map the newly found DTXSIDs back into the NA slots of df_mapped
idx <- match(df_mapped$CAS, ctx_res$searchValue)
needs_fill <- is.na(df_mapped$DTXSID)
df_mapped$DTXSID[needs_fill] <- ctx_res$dtxsid[idx[needs_fill]]

# 4. Save the completed dataset and verify remaining NAs
sum(is.na(df_mapped$DTXSID))


```



```{r}

dtxsids <- df_mapped %>%
  pull(DTXSID) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  trimws() %>%
  unique()

dtxsids <- dtxsids[
  !is.na(dtxsids) & grepl("^DTXSID[0-9]+$", dtxsids)
]

length(dtxsids)

```


```{r}
test <- get_bioactivity_details_batch(
  DTXSID = head(dtxsids, 5),
  rate_limit = 0.2
)

test_df <- rbindlist(test, fill = TRUE)

View(test_df)

```

```{r}

# Split into batches of 25
batches <- split(
  dtxsids,
  ceiling(seq_along(dtxsids) / 25)
)

# Create folder
dir.create("bioactivity_batches", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Download all batches
for (i in seq_along(batches)) {

  file <- paste0("bioactivity_batches/batch_", i, ".rds")

  if (file.exists(file)) next

  cat("Downloading batch", i, "of", length(batches), "\n")

  tryCatch({

    result <- get_bioactivity_details_batch(
      DTXSID = batches[[i]],
      rate_limit = 0.2
    )

    saveRDS(result, file)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Batch ", i, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}


```

```{r}

files <- list.files(
  "bioactivity_batches",
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

bioactivity_all <- rbindlist(
  unlist(lapply(files, readRDS), recursive = FALSE),
  fill = TRUE
)

View(bioactivity_all)

```


```{r}
write.csv(
  bioactivity_all,
  "plastic_additives_bioactivity.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
library(ctxR)
# Fetch chemical data for Bisphenol A (BPA) using its DTXSID
bpa_details <- get_chemical_details(DTXSID = "DTXSID7020182")

# View the resulting data frame or table
print(bpa_details)


```

```{r}
library(ctxR)
# Retrieve property values like boiling point or molecular weight
hazard_data <- get_hazard_by_dtxsid(DTXSID = "DTXSID7020182")

```

```{r}

bpa_bioactivity <- get_bioactivity_details(DTXSID = "DTXSID7020182")

```


```{r}
library(ctxR)

# Dibutyl phthalate (CAS 84-74-2)
bio <- get_bioactivity_details("DTXSID2021781")


# Look for transcriptomics / gene-expression assay results
if (is.data.frame(bio)) {
  matches <- grepl(
    "transcript|gene expression|HTTr",
    apply(bio, 1, paste, collapse = " "),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
  gene_assays <- bio[matches, , drop = FALSE]
  print(gene_assays)
}

```
